overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains an active and highly specialized academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, with a primary focus on computational social science, disinformation research, and tool releases. Across 7 recent posts, his content generated strong engagement among a combined audience of 3,580 followers, driven predominantly by high interaction rates on Bluesky and total volume on LinkedIn.

contentThemes.description: Announcements regarding newly published research papers and software updates like CooRnet v2.0.
Discussions and conference presentations focused on coordinated inauthentic behavior and computational detection methods.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral researchers and research opportunities for PhD students.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's high amplification (reposts) to broadcast open PhD and Postdoc positions across decentralized networks.
Include direct hyperlinks and visual media (infographics, publication covers) to improve click-through and engagement on LinkedIn and Mastodon.
Maintain a consistent cross-posting schedule across all three platforms while tailoring tone—professional networking for LinkedIn and conversational research sharing for Bluesky/Mastodon.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest average engagement rate (~6.14%), with strong resharing/repost rates on research announcements and academic opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a focused academic niche on the aoir.social instance, yielding solid interaction on open-source tool updates like CooRnet v2.0.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest total engagement volume (likes and comments) driven by broad professional announcements such as research grants and hiring calls.
